research_status: Exact source-OpenSCAD CSG of existing unapproved 2026 procedural rig; not an accepted original 1994 mechanical model.

source.parameter_scope: Existing source rig_frame_mass limited to inclusive [1.0,2.0]; exactly one parameter varied.
source.part_modules: tire() and fork_and_frame() from exact unchanged file; each translated by OpenSCAD [0,0,1].

method.validation: Each resulting STL triangulated into a watertight, consistently wound 3D intersection mesh after standard mesh processing; positive signed enclosed volume independently checked.
method.measured_dimension: 3D model coordinates cubed, NOT pixels or source 1994 physical dimensions

interpretation: The modest original 2D silhouette IoU gains from increasing frame mass occur alongside a 4.63x to 15.53x increase in REAL source-authored 3D fork/tire solid intersection volume. Some overlap is present already at 1.0 and may reflect source-authored assembly/axle placement; increased collision volume should be visually and mechanically reviewed, not automatically called an impossible physical design. This is a negative-control tradeoff for selecting unapproved geometry by silhouette score alone.
